config.enbeons_custom_books.title: Enbeon's Custom Books Config
config.enbeons_custom_books.option.modEn: If disabled, Enchanted Books use the default texture.
config.enbeons_custom_books.option.mendi: Controls whether the texture for Enchanted Books with Mending is animated.
config.enbeons_custom_books.option.oldUn: If enabled, Enchanted Books with Unbreaking lose the black binding on their texture.
config.enbeons_custom_books.option.books: Controls whether the custom textures for Enchanted Books should be previewed in the texture precedence config screen. Disabling this can improve config screen load times.
config.enbeons_custom_books.option.prece: Each enchantment in the list has priority over every enchantment below it. Enchanted Books take on the texture of their highest-priority enchantment.
